metadata.title: Clicked like a confused pigeon and somehow snatched 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic is broken
metadata.description:
Spammed clicks like I was chasing a fly.
Enemy probably paused to question reality.
Did NOT deserve that chaos but hey, I’m cashing in on luck.
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, this one’s for you.

Click if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!
